verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own automatic categorization of imported transactions: up to 98% auto-categorization, 98% categorized for connected Brex feeds, and an "ask AI" button for categorization help. No evidence shows the system learns from a user's corrections; custom rules are a user-defined, adjacent mechanism and earn no credit for learning. Missing for 10: documented learning from user corrections, detail on how suggestions are surfaced and accepted, independent or hands-on corroboration of categorization accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can get automatic categorization suggestions for imported transactions that learn from my corrections

citations.quote: 98% transactions categorized When you connect Brex with Puzzle
A user can click on a button and “ask AI” for help in categorizing a transaction —without context switching between tools.
